memory_candidates.content: Vardi-Wolper 1986 (LICS) and other 1980s-era PDFs from ORBi and author homepages are often scanned image PDFs (PDF 1.2). pdftotext produces 0 lines. OCR with tesseract is required for text extraction. Check with: pdftotext file.pdf - | wc -l -- if 0, it is image-based.

CiteSeerX SSL certificate issues can be bypassed with curl --insecure for academic PDF retrieval. Always verify file content after download: head -c 5 file.pdf | grep -q '%PDF' plus check with pdfinfo to confirm page count and readable content.

IFMO mirror at https://is.ifmo.ru/books/ hosts several MIT Press and other textbooks including Baier-Katoen Principles of Model Checking (994 pages, 5.6MB). Widely used academic mirror. Download with curl -L --max-time 60.
